qualification.education_qualification: M.E./M.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Materials Science, Bioengineering, Nanotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology (specialisations related to molecular biology, cell culture, image or signal processing, or allied fields), or M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Physics or Computer Science, with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (55% or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ST/PwD) and valid GATE/NET
qualification.details: Qualification: M.E./M. Tech. in Biomedical Engineering Biotechnology/ Materials Science/Bioengineering/Nanotechnology / Chemical Engineering/Computer Science/ Information Technology with specializations related to molecular biology, cell culture, image or signal processing, or any allied fields; OR M.Sc. in Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Life Sciences/Physics/Computer Science from a recognized University/ from a recognized Institute; Minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale; for SC/ST/PwD a minimum 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA; Valid GATE/NET Age limit: Maximum 32 years Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Woman/PWD Upper age limit exceeded by up to 5 years | Other conditions: | Valid GATE/NET is required

salary_details.pay_scale: Fellowship Rs. 42,000 + Rs. 12,600 (30% HRA) = Rs. 54,600 per month

how_to_apply: Prepare an application letter on plain paper, a recent bio-data, marksheets and certificates, all self-attested.
Mention a valid e-mail id and phone number in the application.
Send the soft copies by e-mail to Dr. Ananya Barui, Project Investigator, at [email protected].
Send within 7 days of the date of publication of the advertisement.
Email it on or before 26 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applications must mention a valid e-mail id and phone number for communicating the date of interview Physical documents will be verified at the time of joining Selection will be cancelled if any discrepancies are found in the documents at physical verification Interview date and time will be notified via email/mobile/institute website
